info.title: Mhon Cloud API
info.description:
Manage your Mhon Cloud servers, containers, DNS names and billing from code.

**Authentication:** create an API key in the console (Overview → API) and send it as `Authorization: Bearer mhc_...`. A key acts as you, on the operations listed here only.

**Credit:** read it with `GET /api/v1/me/credit`. Top-ups and withdrawals are made on the website (Overview → Billing), not through the API.

Amounts are in Thai baht. Times are RFC 3339.

get.description: How much credit you have left. Top up on the website (Overview → Billing).

post.summary: Start, stop, edit (resize) or delete a server
post.description: Resizing charges one month at the new size and refunds the unused time of the current period; deleting refunds the unused time.

disk_gb.description: The boot disk's new size, GB (grow only)

post.description: Pays one more month from your credit and starts it again (the buyer only).

delete.description: Paid containers get the unused time back (all of it if it never ran).

get.summary: CPU / RAM / disk / network of your servers or containers
What a compute instance order can choose (OS, rates, packs, limits)

post.summary: Price a compute instance (nothing is charged)
Order a compute instance (prepaid from your credit)
Cancel an order still waiting for a host (full refund)

get.summary: What a container order can choose

post.summary: Create a DNS name for a container port

put.summary: Point a DNS name at another container / port

get.summary: Current prices and packs (no key needed)

apiKey.description: A personal API key from Overview → API

pending_reboot.description: Resized while running: stop and start it to apply

mine.description: You bought it (renewals take your credit)

order.description: Its Market order; null = not bought in Market

address.description: The public address to reach its ports

random_dns.description: A free vm-xxxxxxxx.mhon.cloud name instead of a public IP

password.description: Optional; only a hash is kept

ContainerOrderRequest.description: Free when within the free plan (1 vCPU / 1 GB / 5 GB); otherwise prepaid from your credit. Uploading folders is only possible from the console.

target.description: What it points at (a container port)

kind.description: web = HTTPS for an HTTP port; direct = A (+ SRV) records for any TCP / UDP port

Forbidden.description: Not allowed (e.g. not the project's owner, or not available with an API key)

E409.description: Not possible in the current state
